source.summary: fix(strutils): stop singularize() mangling words ending in 'ss'

description: singularize() blindly stripped the trailing 's' from any word ending in 's' that missed the earlier '-ies'/'-ses' branches, so already-singular words ending in a double 's' (glass, boss, kiss) were corrupted to 'glas'/'bos'/'kis'. seed/mod.py is the verbatim pre-fix singularize() extracted standalone; seed/mod_fixed.py adds the `elif word.endswith('ss'): return orig_word` branch (the real fix).
